title: Pekin gangsters, Al Capone and the Royal Garden
summary: Working after hours at the Pekin ended amid shootings and gangsters, where he first saw Al Capone; Oliver then got work at the Royal Garden.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: So we worked down there a while, then after that we got out of there, there was so much trouble down there, we lose that job, we close the place up I think. Yeah, there's some shooting on there. Yeah, there's some gangsters there. Yeah, there's some gangsters, that's right. Because that's the first time I've ever seen Al Capone. Yeah, he used to come up there to gang all the time. So after that closed up, somehow Oliver got in touch with working over at Lincoln Garden, it was the Royal Garden there. See. So we had two jobs. We used to go from one place to the other, and so finally got to the place where, I don't know what happened, but anyhow, when we were working at the Dreamland at the time, Oray was up in, that time in Oakland.
